title: &aHow to Play This Pack
subtitle: Keys, tools and friends: what makes the long road easier.

quests.title: Read Me First
quests.subtitle: The Guides tab, and how to use it
desc: The corruption is spreading and the Lantern Corps are watching who rises to meet it. This &aGuides&r tab helps you get ready: one chapter per big mod or system.
Each chapter teaches by doing. Finish a quest, claim its reward, and the next ones open. Start anywhere: the chapters run side by side.
&eCo-op:&r quests belong to your team, so play them together. This chapter shows how.

quests.title: Just Enough Items
quests.subtitle: Every recipe, one key away
desc: &eJEI&r is the item list beside your inventory. Hover any item and press &eR&r for its recipes, or &eU&r for what uses it.
Search with the bar at the bottom. Start with &e@&r to search a mod (&e@create&r, &e@irons&r). Press &eA&r over an item to bookmark it.
Stuck on a quest? Look the item up in JEI first.

quests.title: What Am I Looking At?
desc: &eJade&r shows a small panel at the top of the screen: the block or mob under your crosshair, its health, and which mod it comes from.
Use it to name a strange ore or mob, and to check a machine's progress or a crop's growth without opening anything.

quests.title: Eat Well, Fight Well
desc: &eAppleSkin&r shows how much a food will restore on your hunger bar, and your hidden &esaturation&r (the yellow outline).
Saturation keeps you healing in a long fight. Farmer's Delight meals have the most; see the Farming chapter. Carry real food, not just raw meat.

quests.title: Faster Fingers
desc: &eMouse Tweaks&r speeds up inventories. &eScroll the wheel&r over a stack to move items one at a time into the other inventory.
&eHold Shift and drag&r across slots to move many stacks at once. &eRight-click and drag&r to spread a stack evenly over several slots.

quests.title: Too Many Keys
quests.subtitle: Find and fix keybind clashes
desc: Dozens of mods add keys, and some clash. Open &eOptions > Controls > Key Binds&r: &eControlling&r adds a search box and marks conflicts.
Search a word like &espell&r, &ebackpack&r, &eroll&r or &eultimine&r to find a mod's keys. Fix the red ones now, before a boss fight finds them for you.

quests.title: Form a Team
quests.subtitle: Shared quest progress
desc: Quest progress belongs to your &eFTB Team&r. Make one with the team button in your inventory (the small icons at the top left) or &e/ftbteams party create <name>&r, then &e/ftbteams party invite <player>&r.
Team members share quest progress, but each member claims their own rewards, so nobody misses out.

quests.title: A Party of Your Own
quests.subtitle: Open Parties and Claims
desc: &eOpen Parties and Claims&r (OPAC) guards your land. Its parties are separate from FTB Teams, so make one here too.
Press &e'&r (apostrophe) to open the OPAC menu, choose &eParty&r and create one, then invite your friends by name. You can also type &e/openpac-parties create&r.
Party members can build in each other's claims and see each other on the map.

quests.title: Stake Your Claim
quests.subtitle: Protect your base
desc: Claimed chunks stop other players from breaking your blocks or opening your chests. Open the world map (&eM&r), right-click a chunk (or drag to select several) and pick the claim option. Or stand in the chunk and type &e/openpac-claims claim&r.
Each player can claim up to &e500&r chunks and forceload &e10&r, which keeps farms and machines running while you're away.

quests.title: Share the Spoils
desc: A chest's loot belongs to whoever opens it first, so explore together and share. Be the first to open &e10 loot chests&r.
Open ten structure chests. Shared things (a boss drop on the floor, a feast) are yours to split fairly.

quests.title: The Skill Tree
quests.subtitle: Press K
desc: Press &eK&r to open your skill trees (Pufferfish's Skills). The &eAdventurer&r tree is open to everyone: you earn its points by fighting, exploring and beating bosses.
Each class you join unlocks its own tree. Hover a node to read it, click to spend a point. Some quests in these guides give skill XP too.

quests.title: Watch the Moon
desc: Some nights the moon changes (&eEnhanced Celestials&r). A &cBlood Moon&r brings hordes of undead: get behind walls or fight it out together.
A &9Blue Moon&r makes you lucky, and a &6Harvest Moon&r gives better harvests. A message in chat tells you when each one rises.

quests.title: Two Recipes, One Grid
desc: Sometimes two mods use the same ingredients for different items. &ePolymorph&r then shows a small button next to the crafting result.
Click it to choose which item you want. It works in crafting tables, furnaces and many machines.

quests.title: Ready for the Road
desc: You know the tools. Now pick a chapter: magic, dragons, machines, monsters. Follow whatever you and your friends enjoy most.
The Lantern Corps reward those who keep going. So does this book.
